Georeferenced map of Glen Vowell Band Sik-e-Dakh 2 and Gitanmaax Band Anlaw 4 reserves along the Skeena River clipped from original Plan of the Kispaiax Indian Reserves, Cassiar District (https://doi.org/10.58066/0pk0-vm16). Land cover and features include types of soil and trees.
